newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Imperial Oil debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Imperial Oil debt ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Friday it confirmed its ratings on all series of Imperial Oil Ltd's sinking fund debentures at AA and its commercial paper at R-1 (middle), both with stable trends.
DBRS said the ratings were supported by Imperial's strong balance sheet and favorable cash flow.
It said earnings were expected to remain stable, aided by relatively strong oil prices and the company's cost-cutting measures.

Imperial expects to maintain capitalization and coverage ratios near current levels after its C$1.44-billion stock repurchase, C$843-million income tax refund and debt reduction, DBRS said. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
